AGENTS.md

R package: scDE v0.4.0. Single-package repo (no monorepo). Unified DGE for Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, AnnData and file-backed SCUBA (scuba_source) single-cell objects: cell-level Wilcoxon tests per class, plus a class-agnostic sample-level (pseudobulk) edgeR test whose aggregation is delegated to SCUBA.

Developer commands

devtools::document()    # regenerate man/ + NAMESPACE (roxygen2)
devtools::load_all()    # interactive dev
devtools::test()        # testthat edition 3
devtools::check()       # CRAN-style check
pkgdown::build_site()   # docs site

Tests: tests/testthat/ (edition 3). Skip helpers in helper-skips.R gate three optional tiers: edgeR (>= 4.0.0), a Python with anndata (reticulate), and SCUBA’s Julia engine (SCUBA_JL_PATH pointing at a SCUBA.jl checkout with ScubaR.pseudobulk). Object builders and the hand-aggregated fixture_pseudobulk() live in helper-edger.R.

Generated files — never hand-edit

NAMESPACE and all man/*.Rd are generated by roxygen2 (RoxygenNote: 7.3.3). Always run devtools::document() after changing any @ tags. Manual edits will be overwritten.

Dependencies — non-CRAN remotes

Two deps are GitHub-only and must be installed from the org fork:

remotes::install_github("amc-heme/presto")                              # NOT the CRAN presto
remotes::install_github("amc-heme/SCUBA@feature/julia-engine")      # SCUBA >= 2.0.0.9000 with pseudobulk()

edgeR (>= 4.0.0) is in Suggests, guarded by requireNamespace(); applications that expose the edgeR test (cellDIVER) list it in their own Imports. BPCells is a conditional runtime dep (used inside run_dge.Seurat for IterableMatrix) but not listed in Imports.

AnnData / Python path

run_dge.AnnDataR6 calls reticulate::source_python() on inst/extdata/python/scanpy_dge.py at runtime. Python env must have scanpy, anndata, pandas. Note that the anndata R package >= 0.8 returns plain reticulate objects of class anndata.AnnData, not AnnDataR6; the cell-level methods only dispatch on AnnDataR6, while the pseudobulk path works for both (SCUBA handles the class).

AML_h5ad is a function — call AML_h5ad(), not data(AML_h5ad).

S3 dispatch

run_dge dispatches on object class for the cell-level tests: - Seurat → presto (presto::wilcoxauc) or BPCells (BPCells::marker_features) based on matrix class at runtime - SingleCellExperiment → presto for in-memory matrices, scran (scran::pairwiseWilcox or scran::findMarkers) for DelayedArray-backed matrices; backend controlled by test_use - AnnDataR6 → Python scanpy via reticulate - scuba_source → presto on SCUBA::fetch_matrix() blocks of options(scDE.chunk_features) (2000) features; BH recomputed per group over all features. Presto post-processing shared in .presto_table() (R/run_dge_scuba_source.R). - scuba_pseudobulk (pre-aggregated profiles from SCUBA::pseudobulk()) → edgeR only - default → warning + NULL

test_use = "edgeR" is intercepted in the generic, before UseMethod() (.scde_is_edger() → .scde_run_pseudobulk() in R/run_dge_pseudobulk.R), so it is class-agnostic. Note that UseMethod() re-matches the formals from the original call, so a formal modified in the generic never reaches the method; that is why the deprecated slot argument re-dispatches with an explicit layer.

Pseudobulk edgeR (R/run_dge_pseudobulk.R, R/check_pseudobulk_design.R)

Flow of .scde_run_pseudobulk(): 1. SCUBA::pseudobulk_design(object, sample_by, group_by) — metadata only, no expression read. Per-cell sample ids (median profile size < 2) error. 2. check_pseudobulk_design() (exported; the same policy cellDIVER shows before a run): a profile counts when n_cells >= min_cells; design is paired when a sample has both sides (fit ~ sample + group, test the group coefficient) else independent (~ 0 + group, contrast group_1 - group_2); edgeR needs min_replicates (2) samples per side or paired samples, warns below 3. group_2 = "rest" pools the other groups per sample. 3. Replicated → SCUBA::pseudobulk() once (never materialises cells x features), .scde_validate_pseudobulk_counts() on the small matrix (integer-valued, finite, fun == "sum"), .scde_contrast_counts() (rest = column sums of member profiles), .scde_test_edger(): DGEList → filterByExpr(group=) → normLibSizes("TMM") → glmQLFit(robust=) (edgeR 4 estimates dispersion itself; no estimateDisp) → glmQLFTest(contrast | coef) → topTags(sort.by = "none"). 4. Not replicated → automatic fallback to the object’s cell-level Wilcoxon (.scde_cell_level_contrast(): run_dge() on the cells of the two groups via .scde_subset_cells(), or the one-vs-rest rows of a full run for "rest"), with a message(). Pre-aggregated objects error instead.

Output: method (“edgeR” | “wilcoxon”) first, then group, feature, avgExpr, log2FC, pval, pval_adj (fallback rows also carry auc, pct_in, pct_out); class scDE_edger_results for edgeR; attr edger_details: method, design_type ("independent" | "paired" | NA), group_1, group_2, min_cells, fallback_reason, sample_summary(group, retained_samples, excluded_samples), retained_profiles, excluded_profiles(+ exclusion_reason), design_matrix, contrast | coef, genes_tested, normalization_method, normalization_factors, robust, aggregation(assay, layer, fun, engine, source_class). cellDIVER reads sample_summary, excluded_profiles, design_type and fallback_reason; keep those names stable. avgExpr is edgeR’s average log2-CPM.

run_dge_multicontrast() aggregates once (only if any contrast is replicated), runs edgeR per replicated contrast and the fallback per unreplicated one (one-vs-rest fallbacks share a single cell-level run), binds the union schema (group_1, group_2, contrast, method, ...; NA where a column does not apply), applies p_adjust_scope before positive_only, and stores contrast_table (with method, design_type, reason) in edger_multicontrast_details. A contrast that fails for a reason other than replication aborts the call.

There is no pseudobulk Wilcoxon option (removed in 0.4.0); the cell-level Wilcoxon is the only fallback.

Output column normalization by backend

Each backend produces different raw names; they’re normalized to a common schema. Key renames: - Presto: padj → pval_adj, logFC → log2FC - BPCells: foreground → group, p_val_raw → pval, foreground_mean → avgExpr; pval_adj added via BH - AnnData: names → feature, logfoldchanges → log2FC, pvals → pval, pvals_adj → pval_adj - edgeR: logCPM → avgExpr, logFC → log2FC, PValue → pval, FDR → pval_adj

Final sort: group, pval_adj, desc(abs(log2FC)) (multicontrast: contrast, pval_adj, desc(abs(log2FC))).

Known limitations / gotchas

  • run_dge.AnnDataR6 ignores the layer param entirely — always uses X matrix. This is acknowledged in the code.
  • BPCells path uses object[[seurat_assay]]$data hardcoded (Assay5), not layer-parameterized.
  • slot param deprecated in 0.2.0, replaced by layer. Removal at 1.0.0.
  • SingleCellExperiment method uses scran for Wilcoxon testing. Requires Bioconductor: BiocManager::install(c("scran", "SummarizedExperiment")) — listed in Suggests, so not auto-installed. Guards use requireNamespace() with actionable error messages.
    • Default layer: "logcounts".
    • Backend controlled by test_use param (also on the generic, ignored by other methods):
      • NULL (default): auto-detects — "Presto" for in-memory matrices, "scran" for DelayedArray-backed (e.g. HDF5Array).
      • "Presto": presto::wilcoxauc on the extracted matrix directly (.default method). Output matches Seurat/presto schema: includes auc, pct_in, pct_out. Errors informatively if matrix is DelayedArray.
      • "scran": true one-vs-rest via scran::pairwiseWilcox per group; result indexed directly by pair position (avoids combineMarkers, which fails in scran ≥1.36). Binary factor with explicit levels c(g, "other") ensures g is always in pairs$first. Returns auc column. LFC computed from group means (subtraction in log space, divided by log(2) to yield log2FC). avgExpr via MatrixGenerics::rowMeans2() (supports DelayedArray); other_mean derived algebraically — no additional matrix reads.
      • "scran_pairwise": scran::findMarkers(pval.type = "any") pairwise approach. log2FC computed from group vs. all-other-cells means (same algebraic method as "scran") — findMarkers wilcox output has no reliable summary LFC (scran bug, unfixed as of 1.40). No auc column.
  • Package uses %>% (magrittr), not base |>.
